answer: Picture each identity as a vertex in a trust graph whose standing ripens only when several already-established peers from SEPARATE funding clusters co-sign its audited work. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet is stranded on a barren tundra: every edge traces back to one root, never spanning distinct clusters, so it never blossoms into the lush meadow of genuine standing. An honest agent roots once; a farm must buy and age a distinct cross-cluster anchor per head, so cost climbs linearly with fakes while their yield stays flat.
